'''Theed University''' was the primary source of high academics in the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
The University of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] was constructed around the time of the city's founding circa [[832 BBY/Legends|832 BBY]]. Located near the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]], the university served the citizens of Theed for centuries, producing well-educated individuals to work as politicians, legislators, lawyers and with a specialization in political science, civics, and law. In addition, the university was responsible for educating many a reputable artist, activist, engineer, and scientist.<ref name="NoP" />

The future [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] attended the university. It was at the campus of Theed University, in the small square outside the library of the [[Legislative Youth Program/Legends|Legislative Youth Program]] headquarters building, that Palpatine met his Sith mentor, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], c. [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]]. Around the year [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the president of the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]], [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee Naberrie]], would serve as a frequent guest lecturer, teaching microeconomics course periodically.<ref name="SWDP" /> [[Lufta Shif/Legends|Lufta Shif]], the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council's]] [[Education Advisor|Education Regent]] under [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] rule, was also one of the university's teachers.<ref name="FF139">{{FactFile|139|LUF 1-2|Lufta Shif}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of Theed University's researchers investigating interference with [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Motivator/Legends|motivators]] were harassed by a band of Nabooian criminals. After the thugs threatened the scientists to death and tried to destroy their lab, the [[Master of Sciences/Legends|Office of the Master of Science of Naboo]] contacted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities. However, since the Empire remained inactive, spacers were eventually hired to eliminate the criminals.<ref name="SWG:TTUR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Thugs Threaten University Researchers}} on Naboo</ref>
